scope: Targeted primary-source leads in previously unresearched jurisdictions. A blocked record is a traceable follow-up, not a confirmed section or an implemented profile.

records.organisation: Puerto Rico Highway and Transportation Authority
records.locator: Chapter 6, prestressed-concrete beam shapes and transfer-strength provisions (indexed text; PDF retrieval blocked)
records.printed_dimensions: No outline dimensions verified. The manual states transfer compressive strength 4,500 psi for Types V and VI, versus 4,000 psi for other beam types; these are material strengths, not dimensions.
records.missing_information: Historical 1979 guidance only. Verify whether superseded and which AASHTO sections were used on actual Puerto Rico bridges. Obtain beam drawings or current PRHTA guidance before assigning jurisdiction coverage to a specific profile.
records.contact_route: Puerto Rico Highway and Transportation Authority, via act.dtop.pr.gov

records.organisation: National Works Agency; CL Environmental Co. Ltd
records.title_original: Environmental Impact Assessment for the Proposed Road Improvement Project from Harbour View, Kingston to Yallahs, St. Thomas (Section 1A of the Southern Highway Improvement Project)
records.locator: printed p. 95, bridge construction method and post-tensioning subsections
records.missing_information: The EIA confirms proposed prefabricated hollow concrete slab/beams and prestressed concrete T beams, but neither has a section designation or cross-section. Request project bridge general-arrangement and girder drawings from NWA.

records.organisation: Environmental Protection Department, Hong Kong SAR
records.title_original: Central–Wan Chai Bypass and Island Eastern Corridor Link Environmental Impact Assessment, Chapter 2
records.locator: §2.5.2, transition to the Island Eastern Corridor
records.missing_information: The project source specifies a precast U-beam matching the existing Island Eastern Corridor configuration, but supplies no beam variant, outline, or dimensions. Obtain the project's structural drawings; a generic U-beam mention cannot be instantiated as a profile.
records.contact_route: Hong Kong Environmental Protection Department EIA register; Highways Department project office

records.organisation: Royal Government of Bhutan, Department of Roads, Bridge Division
records.title_original: Construction of Dopshari Bridge, Paro: Prestressed Concrete Girder Bridge Drawings
records.locator: drawing index DSZ-SUP-07 Girder Plan, DSZ-SUP-08 Girder Section, DSZ-SUP-10 Sections of the Bridge; title block gives 29.10 m span
records.printed_dimensions: Title block gives 29.10 m span and 7.00 m carriageway; no beam cross-section dimensions verified.
records.missing_information: The indexed drawing set contains a girder-section sheet, but direct PDF retrieval failed and precast fabrication of this particular girder is unverified. Visually inspect DSZ-SUP-08 and the bill of quantities before treating it as a precast section.
records.contact_route: Bhutan Department of Roads, Bridge Division, via moit.gov.bt

records.organisation: Mauritius Ministry of Environment; Preskil renovation design team
records.title_original: Preskil Renovation: Design Concept for Civil Works
records.locator: Design Concept for Civil Works, §1.0–1.1, drawing 17-143-SW1 reference
records.printed_dimensions: A clear water passage of at least 7.0 m is specified; no beam dimensions are printed in the accessible text.
records.missing_information: The concept explicitly specifies precast beams and identifies drawing 17-143-SW1, but the accessible text contains no beam type or contour. Inspect the drawing and seek final construction drawings; the source is a proposal, not as-built evidence.
records.contact_route: Mauritius Ministry of Environment EIA repository; project design team named in appendix
